apple.name: Quiet Shot
apple.subtitle: One-shot mirror puzzle
apple.description: Aim once, fire, and predict how a ray reflects from fixed mirrors to clear every target. Adjust your angle and retry without a timer. Explore eight original boards and save progress locally. A shot stops when targets are cleared, it leaves the board, or the four-reflection limit is reached.
